summary: Forest, Desert and Ice Titan trophies lead into King Titan. In ASA, King Titan ascension increases the survivor level cap, and progression runs Gamma → Beta → Alpha. This is an open-world battle.
sharedPreparation: Record difficulty, Single Player Settings and mods before comparing your army with official-server videos.
Start with Gamma; measure health, ammunition and saddle losses before raising difficulty. Total creature level is not a substitute for actual stats.
Keep a breeding pair and spare equipment at base. Fully heal the team and rehearse whistle groups before summoning.
Check tribute, permitted creatures, timer and rewards at the current ASA terminal; do not copy ASE requirements.
Separate trophy-kill and corruption-taming plans. Do not send an uncontrolled army into a Titan you intend to tame.
For King Titan, rehearse retreat commands and assign corrupted-creature control separately from boss damage. Plan Element and Mek supplies before starting.

steps.title: 1 · City supplies and defense events
steps.reason: Build ammunition, saddle and resource reserves. Choose OSD or Element Vein difficulty your team can sustain through the waves.

steps.title: 2 · Forest, Desert and Ice Titan
steps.reason: Choose killing for trophies or taming for support. Taming requires removing body corruption while limiting damage to the Titan itself.

steps.title: 3 · King Titan and ascension
steps.reason: Retain the previous-difficulty King Titan trophy for the next summon. Prepare open-world support and the Alpha-only Mega Mek; the wandering King Titan event is a separate activity.

loadouts.entry: Decide whether this summon is a trophy kill or a tame.
loadouts.warning: No numeric army thresholds are verified here. Check current encounter eligibility and your save settings.

options.title: Bladewasp Hive · ASA kill plan
options.team: A Bladewasp Hive on an elevated pillar setup or a Quetzal platform.
options.why: The Desert Titan page explicitly describes this ASA killing approach; it does not preserve a Titan for taming.
options.play: Confirm access to Bladewasp content and building/platform rules. Use the setup for a kill, not for controlled corruption removal.
options.confidence: Current Wiki encounter guidance; no independently measured ASA minimum stats or guaranteed win.

sources.title: Desert Titan · ASA kill option
sources.note: The indexed page explicitly identifies the Bladewasp Hive approach as ASA. No numeric stat threshold or guaranteed time is claimed.

loadouts.entry: Use open-world combat roles; this is not a standard arena herd.
loadouts.warning: No numeric army thresholds are verified here. Check current encounter eligibility and your save settings.

options.title: Titans with coordinated support
options.team: Tamed Titans and support damage dealers, with assigned corrupted-creature control.
options.why: The current King Titan reference describes Titan support; protect the team from area attacks and knockback.
options.play: Move out of meteor impact areas and retreat when the boss recovers from a downed phase. Keep support away from the immediate melee impact zone.
options.confidence: Current shared ASE/ASA Wiki mechanics reference; a planning guide, not an independently tested ASA army threshold.

options.title: Alpha · Mega Mek plan
options.team: A piloted Mega Mek assembled using M.O.M.I. and Meks, with support roles as needed.
options.why: Mega Mek deployment is restricted to Alpha King Titan; it changes the boss’s damage resistance.
options.play: Prepare assembly and controls before Alpha. Keep the Mega Mek active and avoid getting trapped by terrain; do not apply this plan to Gamma or Beta.
options.confidence: Current shared ASE/ASA Wiki reference with ASA Mek fixes; no solo-win guarantee or minimum blueprint stats.
